metadata.description: Primary location for all resources
Environment name used for resource naming
Azure OpenAI model deployment name
Actual model behind the deployment (gpt-4o-mini AND gpt-4.1-mini are in deprecating state — blocked for NEW deployments as of 2026-07; gpt-5-mini deprecates 2027-02)
Azure OpenAI model version
ACS source phone number (provisioned manually)
Existing ACS resource name (provisioned manually via Portal)
Existing ACS endpoint (provisioned manually via Portal)
Location override for Cosmos DB (use when primary region has capacity issues)
Location override for Azure AI Speech. Place near your callers (e.g. westeurope for EU) to cut TTS/STT first-byte latency. Defaults to the primary location.
Location override for Azure AI Search (use when primary region lacks capacity for the chosen SKU). Search latency is not on the voice path.

Location override for the Container Apps environment + apps (use when primary region reports AKSCapacityHeavyUsage). Adds a small network hop to Speech/OpenAI; remove once primary region has capacity.
OpenAI deployment SKU. Use GlobalStandard in regions (e.g. westeurope) that do not offer Standard for gpt-4o-mini.
Run agent + orchestrator in rule-based mode (no Azure OpenAI at runtime).
TTS voice for the agent.
Enable bidirectional media streaming (low-latency voice path).
Speech end-of-utterance segmentation timeout (ms) for the streaming path.
Pause (ms) before the greeting so the caller can say hello first.
Speech recognition language (e.g. en-GB).
ACS connection string. Set for connection-string auth; leave empty to use managed identity.

Deploy Azure Cache for Redis (lowest-latency session store). Set false where it is unavailable/retired; the orchestrator then uses the Cosmos-backed session store — horizontal scale is preserved either way.
Max orchestrator replicas. Sized for 200k alarms/month with burst headroom; requires a shared session store (Redis or Cosmos), which this template always provides.
Customer webhook that receives terminal call results (JSON POST). Empty = disabled; consumers can poll GET /api/alarm-status instead.
HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing outcome webhook payloads (X-Callout-Signature header). Empty = unsigned.
API key required on POST /api/alarm-intent and the status endpoints (X-API-Key header). Empty = open (dev only).
Voice engine for the media-streaming path: chained (Speech STT/TTS), realtime (GPT speech-to-speech) or voicelive (managed Voice Live API).
Voice for the realtime speech-to-speech engine.
Voice Live endpoint (Foundry/AI Services or Speech resource). Empty = use the Speech account deployed by this template.
Voice Live managed model (no deployment/quota needed): gpt-realtime, gpt-realtime-mini, ...
Voice for the Voice Live engine — any Azure neural voice.
Container image for the orchestrator
Container image for the agent
Actual model behind the deployment. May differ from deploymentName so app config stays stable when a model is deprecated for new deployments.
Deployment SKU. Some regions (e.g. westeurope) only offer GlobalStandard for gpt-4o-mini, not Standard.
Deploy the gpt-realtime speech-to-speech model (used when STREAMING_ENGINE=realtime).
Azure region for the resource
Name for the Azure AI Search resource
SKU for Azure AI Search
Resource tags
Location for the Service Bus namespace.
Globally unique Service Bus namespace name.
Tags applied to all resources.
Queue name used by the orchestrator.
SKU. Standard supports topics and is the cheapest with the features we need.
Service Bus namespace (without .servicebus.windows.net). Empty = no queue scaler.
Service Bus queue name. Required if serviceBusNamespace is set.
Target messages per replica. KEDA adds a replica per N messages backlog.
Max replicas. Keep at 1 when there is no shared session store (in-memory state is per-replica).
vCPU cores (valid ACA combo with memory, e.g. 0.5/1Gi, 1.0/2Gi, 2.0/4Gi).
Memory size (must pair with cpuCores per ACA rules).

variables.queueScaler: [if(empty(parameters('serviceBusNamespace')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'queue-depth-scaling', 'custom', createObject('type', 'azure-servicebus', 'metadata', createObject('namespace', parameters('serviceBusNamespace'), 'queueName', parameters('serviceBusQueueName'), 'messageCount', string(parameters('serviceBusMessagesPerReplica'))), 'identity', 'system'))))]
